# Orra

Dummy lighting shop and Orra Studio SaaS. Agents run in the visitor browser from orra_concierge.network.json. Mutations go through App.page. Spend caps refuse over-limit checkout. Undo reverses the ledger.

Catalog: Arc Sconce $172, Mill Pendant $240, Grove Floor Lamp $410, Linen Throw $86, Kiln Bowl $54, North Rug $320.

Studio: Starter $0, Pro $29, Atelier $79 per month.

Register: POST /api/v1/agents/register. MCP: POST /mcp. Freight partner: http://127.0.0.1:8081/freight_guide.
